master.prompt:
Create a single complete loaded game vehicle Arctic Ocelot, arctic-ocelot-20. Brief: 

- Vehicle: signal red 4×4 pickup scout with an open bed
- Load (drawn as part of the vehicle): red explosives crates with hazard stripes and a flag
- Equipment: roof rack with jerry cans and recovery boards
- Finish: mud-caked lower panels
- Tires: 1.60 m spiked tires: off-road mud-terrain tires studded with rows of short steel spikes

. Exactly TWO near-side road wheels (two axles). Vehicle empty mass 5.5 tonnes; whole vehicle length about 6.4 metres. Its load is integrated securely using straps, chains, cradles or side rails. Draw the full coupled tractor AND trailer as ONE image when present, not separate parts. Keep all near-side tires unobstructed by steps. For banners or flags use blank bold colours, no lettering. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Facing RIGHT, cab front face invisible. Exactly circular near tires, centred rims, level hub centres and tire bottoms. Horizontal chassis and deck, no yaw, no tilt. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration in approved Swamp Scout style: dark readable contours, weathered materials, fine mechanical detail, rich natural texture. Soft even daylight. True transparent background, no ground, cast shadow, glow, lettering, logos or watermark. Entire object has generous clear margins on all four sides, occupies only central 85% of canvas width and 80% of height. Wide PNG at least 1500 pixels across.

body.prompt: Edit supplied Arctic Ocelot master-v4 into animated body layer: remove ONLY both road tires, spikes and rims completely. Keep exact canvas, body, cargo, flag, paint, chassis, position and scale. Fill each upper wheel arch with opaque painted dark inner liner, suspension, axle and chassis from fender lip down to ORIGINAL horizontal hub line; no transparency anywhere above hubs, below hubs transparent. No remaining tire or rim. Do not move, resize or redraw truck. True transparent background, no halo. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires.
body.role: Generated wheel-well interior donor; composite preserves original non-wheel pixels.
